notes_for_editor: Thin record. Sources are the two FFLA Virginia lists, a Virginia index on the Forest Lookouts site, and the Wikipedia article on James City County for the 1884 independence date. No NHLR or FFLOS entry, no dated history, no staffing or access information, no photo. Searches returned only Colonial Williamsburg and general history pages. The name belongs to the independent city, but the record and FFLA both place the tower in James City County. Do not confuse it with us-va-james-city (James City Fire Tower near Toano, standing, 37.43441, -76.83196); by my calculation the two points are about 23 km apart. The 1928 and 1991 sentences describe the statewide program; no source ties this site to it.
